此版本为原生架构重建前最后一个版本。
This is the final release before the native architecture rebuild.

## 全新设置界面

设置界面重做，串流、显示、音频、键鼠、手柄和更新各成一页，支持搜索具体选项。

- 串流菜单、连接设置和诊断提示补齐中英文（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)）。
- 改进局域网发现（[#33](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/33)、[#35](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/35)）。

## DualSense 与手柄

支持 DualSense 的电量、动作、震动和灯光反馈，触控板提供透传和 Mac 风格两种模式。

- 长按 Options 切换触控板模式。
- 触控板轻点、自然滚动和松手更稳，光标跳动减少。

## 性能诊断

新增性能诊断和报告导出（[#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)）。

- 提供帧率、1% low、网络与画面抖动、丢帧和音频欠载数据。
- 尝试改善流畅度与帧统计异常。

## 其他改进

- 配合 Foundation Sunshine，支持显示器与虚拟显示器配置，文本和图片剪贴板互通（[#32](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/32)）。
- 新增独立的 10-bit SDR 设置（[#22](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/22)）。
- 新增应用内更新界面和测试版渠道。
- 改进串流启动与原生解码，开始串流时显示加载动画。
- 使用独立的应用身份，可与 Qt 版本共存（[#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)）。

## 修复

- 修复自由鼠标模式下，鼠标悬停或 ⌘Tab 切换应用后串流窗口自动抢回焦点（[#21](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/21)、[#40](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/40)）。
- 修复单独 ⌘ 键映射 Windows 键，改善 Ctrl、Shift 和快捷键翻译的按键释放（[#23](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/23)、[#37](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/37)）。
- 修正自定义分辨率输入和码率设置范围（[#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)）。
- 修正 Metal 启动时的回调配置错误。
- 尝试修复：锁定鼠标无法移动、控制菜单返回后失去响应（[#24](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/24)、[#49](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/49)）；macOS 12 上开始串流时崩溃（[#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)）；部分手柄的映射和方向异常（[#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)）；DNF 中方向键失灵（[#39](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/39)）；HDR 泛白与过曝（[#29](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/29)）。

**需要**：显示器与虚拟显示器配置、剪贴板互通需要 Foundation Sunshine。

## 候选版本说明

- 本候选版请从发布页手动下载安装，应用内更新渠道准备中。
- 这是预发布版本，欢迎通过对应 issue 反馈；仍然遇到同类问题时，请附上系统版本、主机版本、输入设备和日志。
- 支持 Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 和 HDR10+，不支持时安全回退，最终效果取决于系统、硬件和显示链路；HDR Vivid 暂不可用。
- USB 转发和主机文件是实验性功能，需要支持并启用对应功能的 Foundation Sunshine；主机文件为只读，Finder 挂载另需支持该功能的签名版本。

- 尝试修复部分手柄的映射与方向输入异常，完善手柄类型识别、映射诊断及输入暂停时的状态释放（[#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)）。DualSense 支持电量、动作、震动和灯光反馈，提供触控板透传与 Mac 风格模式，可长按 Options 切换。

- 增加性能诊断和报告导出，提供帧率、1% low、网络及帧呈现抖动、丢帧和音频欠载数据，尝试改善流畅度与统计异常（[#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)）。

#### 候选版本说明

- Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 与 HDR10+ 提供能力探测、适配和安全回退；最终输出受系统、硬件和显示链路影响。HDR Vivid 当前不可用。
- USB 转发和主机文件为实验性能力，需要支持并启用对应功能的 Foundation Sunshine。主机文件为只读访问，Finder 挂载还需要支持相应 App Group 的签名版本。

---

## New settings

The settings are rebuilt: Streaming, Display, Audio, Keyboard & Mouse, Controllers and Updates each have a page, with search down to individual options.

- Stream menus, connection settings and diagnostic notices are fully in Chinese and English ([#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)).
- Improved LAN discovery ([#33](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/33), [#35](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/35)).

## DualSense and controllers

Supports DualSense battery, motion, rumble and light feedback, with a passthrough and a Mac-style touchpad mode.

- Hold Options to switch the touchpad mode.
- Steadier taps, natural scrolling and release, with less cursor jitter.

## Performance diagnostics

Added performance diagnostics and report export ([#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)).

- Frame rate, 1% low, network and presentation jitter, dropped frames and audio underruns.
- Attempted to improve smoothness and frame-statistics anomalies.

## More improvements

- With Foundation Sunshine: display and virtual display configuration, and text and image clipboard sync ([#32](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/32)).
- Added a separate 10-bit SDR setting ([#22](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/22)).
- Added an in-app update interface and a beta channel.
- Improved stream startup and native decoding, with a loading indicator while a stream starts.
- The app has its own identity and can coexist with the Qt client ([#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)).

## Fixes

- Fixed stream windows taking focus back in Free Mouse mode after hovering or switching apps with ⌘Tab ([#21](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/21), [#40](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/40)).
- Fixed standalone ⌘-to-Windows-key handling and key release for Ctrl, Shift and shortcut translation ([#23](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/23), [#37](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/37)).
- Corrected custom resolution input and the bitrate range ([#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)).
- Corrected a callback setup error at Metal startup.
- Attempted to fix: locked mouse not moving, and the control menu not responding after you return to the stream ([#24](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/24), [#49](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/49)); stream-start crashes on macOS 12 ([#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)); some controller mapping and direction problems ([#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)); arrow keys not working in DNF ([#39](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/39)); washed-out or overexposed HDR ([#29](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/29)).

**Requirements:** display and virtual display configuration and clipboard sync need Foundation Sunshine.

## About this candidate

- Install this candidate manually from the release page; the in-app update channel is being prepared.
- This is a prerelease. If an issue persists, please report it on the matching issue with your OS, host version, input device and logs.
- Supports Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+, falling back safely where unsupported; the final result depends on the system, hardware and display path. HDR Vivid is unavailable.
- USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and need a Foundation Sunshine that supports and enables them. Host Files is read-only; Finder mounting also needs a signed build that supports it.

<details><summary>Detailed changes</summary>

#### RC1

- Reorganized SwiftUI settings and added option-level search.
- Expanded Chinese and English localization across streaming controls, connection settings, and diagnostics (#30).
- Improved LAN discovery, permission declarations, and address probing when the preferred route is unavailable (#33, #35).
- Fixed background stream windows stealing focus in Free Mouse mode after pointer hover or Command-Tab (#21, #40).
- Fixed standalone Command-to-Windows-key handling and improved modifier release during shortcut translation (#23, #37).
- Attempted to fix mouse movement and menu-return stalls by refining capture and recovery (#24, #49).
- Improved stream startup and native decoding, added an in-window loading indicator, and corrected Metal startup callback configuration.
- Attempted to fix macOS 12 stream-start crashes with layout reentry protection (#26).
- Attempted to fix controller mapping and directional input issues (#25), and expanded DualSense feedback and switchable touchpad modes.
- Refined DualSense tapping, natural scrolling, axis locking, and release handling.
- Added explicit 10-bit SDR negotiation (#22) and attempted to fix washed-out or overexposed HDR output (#29).
- Added Foundation display configuration and improved clipboard compatibility, with text/image synchronization verified (#32).
- Improved native decoding and diagnostics to address smoothness and frame-statistics anomalies (#31).
- Integrated Sparkle and a beta channel, with GitHub-first downloads and an identical signed CNB archive fallback.
- Corrected custom resolution and bitrate controls and isolated the app identity for coexistence with QT clients (#41).
- Attempted to fix DNF arrow-key input by refining shortcut translation and modifier-state handling (#39).

#### Candidate notes

- Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+ provide capability probing, integration, and safe fallback. Output depends on the system, hardware, and display path. HDR Vivid is unavailable.
- USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and require the corresponding Foundation Sunshine features. Host Files is read-only; Finder mounting also requires a signed build supporting the required App Group.

</details>
